text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I successfully got Suzuka-san's 
calendar! Once I get back, I'm putting it 
right on my room's desk—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(There's so much merchandise... of those 
two. They really are popular, after 
all...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: (Huh? ...Is that Cheval-san?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what's wrong. She looks kind of 
down...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eh... Ah, umm... H-Hello, Spe-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Well, um... P-Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? All of a sudden...!? Umm, errr... 
P-Please wait! Actually, the thing is... I 
have a favor to ask!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Look at all these delicious-looking cakes! 
Wah~! This one is so cute!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Which one would you like? Order whatever 
you want! It's my treat, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's my way of thanking you for going 
along with my sudden wish to go on a 
gourmet tour! Don't hesitate at all!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'll pay for myself. I was... 
getting pretty hungry anyway.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Hmmm... Still, please let me 
pay for at least this one! We still have 
plenty more shops to visit, after all!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-What a stylish shop...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yeah. Ah, this menu... it's all in 
English.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
E-English...!? No, don't worry! Leave this 
to me...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hey! Order, please!

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text: Yes, have you decided?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm Special Week! Berry berry meat eat— 
H-Huh? Japanese?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... There was a Japanese menu as well. 
I-I'm sorry. I caused a 
misunderstanding...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... A-Ahaha, it's totally fine...! 
Please don't worry about it! Now, what 
shall we eat?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—After finishing work. Upon visiting an 
open-air cafe, I spotted Special Week and 
Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We sure toured around a lot. Thank 
you so much for accompanying me today, 
Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-No... thank you...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Having a full stomach really makes you 
happy, doesn't it? I was nervous since I'm 
not used to fancy shops, but everything 
was truly delicious!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...You're not... used to them?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah... E-Ehehe. Actually, that's right. 
Scarlet-san secretly gave me 
recommendations...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She introduced me to places where things 
are sweet, tasty, and can cheer you—wait, 
no, places that can really fill your 
belly!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
H-How was it? Are you completely full in 
both heart and belly—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah...!? Um, w-w-what I just said was—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(............ She's so... incredibly kind. 
I wish I could be like that too...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...It was delicious. Though... I'm still a 
little hungry.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-If you don't mind... um... W-Would you 
like to go together... to, um...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Get ramen...! Or something, what do you 
think...!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
! Ramen! Yes, with pleasure! Ehehe, I 
wonder what kind of ramen I should get~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week was beaming happily, while 
Cheval Grand wore a shy, bashful smile. A 
warm and peaceful atmosphere enveloped 
them.
